[SWS_LinIf_00427] ⌈The parameter ConfigPtr of the function LinTp_Init is only
relevant for the configuration variant VARIANT-POST-BUILD. The parameter Config-
Ptr shall be ignored for the configuration variant VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE and the
configuration variant VARIANT-LINK-TIME.⌋

other LIN TP function.
